snippet.title: Engraving Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
In this horror adventure, your only weapons are ink, paper, and will. Explore shifting paths, chart them by hand, and uncover ancient secrets buried beneath root and stone. Every step takes its toll.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616650/Engraving/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!
https://youtube.com/sixoneindie

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
